faces.name: The Abyss
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, destroy target nonartifact creature that player controls of their choice. It can't be regenerated.

faces.name: The Actualizer
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, read aloud the name, mana cost, type line, power, and toughness of a card in your hand, except lie about one of them. Each opponent simultaneously guesses which one is incorrect. Then reveal the card. Each opponent who guessed incorrectly loses 3 life. You may discard that card and draw a card. (They can't look it up or ask for help as this ability is resolving. Nice try, though.)

faces.name: The Aesir Escape Valhalla
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — Exile a permanent card from your graveyard. You gain life equal to its mana value.
II — Put a number of +1/+1 counters on target creature you control equal to the mana value of the exiled card.
III — Return this Saga and the exiled card to their owner's hand.

faces.name: The Aether Flues
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk to The Aether Flues and at the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle all other cards revealed this way into your library.
Whenever chaos ensues, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.

faces.name: The Aetherspark
faces.oracleText:
As long as The Aetherspark is attached to a creature, The Aetherspark can't be attacked and has "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage during your turn, put that many loyalty counters on The Aetherspark."
+1: Attach The Aetherspark to up to one target creature you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
−5: Draw two cards.
−10: Add ten mana of any one color.

faces.name: The Akroan War
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Gain control of target creature for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield.
II — Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able.
III — Each tapped creature deals damage to itself equal to its power.

faces.name: The Alien Spellslayer
faces.oracleText:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
Whenever The Alien Spellslayer enters or attacks, put a transformation counter on up to one target non-Alien creature. It becomes an Alien that's all colors.
Whenever an Alien you control attacks, it can't be blocked this combat.

faces.name: The Alright Henge
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Add {G}{G}.
Whenever a nontoken creature enters the battlefield under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
